scope: Unreleased follow-up analysis runtime fixes; no fixed release, installed skill update or real novel edits.

findings.problem: CR-only and mixed-newline sources lose chapter boundaries despite preserving source text.
findings.resolution: Recognize LF, CRLF and CR line boundaries without text normalization or re-splitting existing sources.

findings.problem: Concurrent finalization can combine pending chunks from an earlier state with a later final report path.
findings.resolution: Read source progress and report registration in the same database snapshot.

findings.problem: Concurrent ingest can produce a source list whose total and returned rows disagree.
findings.resolution: Read source count, rows and their progress in the same snapshot; preserve caller transactions.

independent_review.scope: Runtime diff and both new test files; nested transactions, errors, chapter boundaries and saved source identity.

local_markdown_links.scope: Inline local Markdown file targets; remote URLs and heading anchors are not checked

limits: Synthetic source fixtures and deterministic two-connection SQLite WAL interleavings, not a production concurrency load test.
Read consistency applies to each response, not to all pages requested at different times.
No literary quality evaluation this round; source and quote checks do not prove interpretations or whole-book completeness.
No new Windows CI run; existing Windows export limitation is outside this change.
